acceptedAnswer.text: Our project start times in Pacifica, Daly City, and other Bay Area locations depend on our current schedule and material availability. Typically, once a quote is approved and materials are ordered, installation can commence within 1-3 weeks. We strive to accommodate urgent requests for vacant units whenever possible. We recommend contacting us as early as you can to discuss your specific timeline and for the most accurate scheduling information.
